THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/DW/01. Ref No. of Land Ministry: 4/3/10/2012/LRB-19. I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below and located in either side of the canal from the beginning part of pepiliyana paddy field to Nugegoda marshy land area and from Nugegoda marshy land area to 120 bus route (Sunethradevi road) to develop Nugegoda canal under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/14. Ref No. of Land Ministry: 4/3/10/2012/LRB-222. I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to creating a water tank in the abandon land between Hikkgahawatta road and Vihara Mawatha at Borales-gamuwa under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.
